caption_used: Training rewards of LLaMA-3.1 8B on the Easy and Hard training sets, displayed as two vertically stacked line plots. In the Easy Training Set (top panel), both Llama-On-Policy-Easy (teal) and Llama-LUFFY-Easy (red) start near 0.0 and increase over 500 steps, with LUFFY reaching approximately 0.4 and On-Policy reaching approximately 0.35 at step 500. In the Hard Training Set (bottom panel), Llama-LUFFY-Hard shows steady improvement from near 0.0 to approximately 0.2 by step 500, while Llama-On-Policy-Hard initially rises to approximately 0.05 before declining back toward 0.0 after step 150. Notably, the performance gap between the two methods is substantially wider on the Easy set, where LUFFY maintains a consistent lead of approximately 0.10 throughout training, compared to the Hard set where their trajectories only clearly diverge after step 200.
raw_response: DESCRIPTION: The figure contains two vertically stacked line charts showing training rewards versus training steps for two methods on two datasets. Both panels use a linear x-axis labeled “Steps” ranging from 0 to 500 with major ticks at 0, 100, 200, 300, 400, and 500, and a linear y-axis labeled “Training Rewards.” The top panel is titled “Easy Training Set” and spans roughly 0.0 to about 0.45 on the y-axis (with labeled ticks at 0.0, 0.2, and 0.4). It includes two solid lines with shaded uncertainty bands: a teal line labeled “Llama-On-Policy-Easy” and a red line labeled “Llama-LUFFY-Easy.” Both start near 0 at step 0 and rise over training; the teal line increases to around 0.25 by ~100 steps and ends near ~0.35 at step 500 with small oscillations, while the red line rises to around ~0.22 by ~100 steps and continues upward to end near ~0.40 at step 500 with visible fluctuations and several local peaks near the upper range late in training. The bottom panel is titled “Hard Training Set” and spans roughly 0.0 to about 0.22 on the y-axis (with labeled ticks at 0.0, 0.1, and 0.2). It also shows two solid lines with shaded bands: a teal line labeled “Llama-On-Policy-Hard” and a red line labeled “Llama-LUFFY-Hard.” The teal line begins slightly above 0 (around a few hundredths), briefly rises early (near ~0.03–0.05 within the first few dozen steps), then declines toward ~0 by roughly 100–150 steps and remains near 0 through step 500, while the red line starts near 0, increases to about ~0.10 by ~100 steps, continues gradually upward with oscillations around ~0.12–0.18 through mid-training, and ends near ~0.20 by step 500.
